title: [GMCP 203.003.05] Interoperability and quality: Modern stateless lifecycle and server discovery
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-003-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: For MCP 2026-07-28 and later GMCP is genuinely stateless at the protocol layer: no initialize ceremony or session identifier is required, every request carries and validates version plus client capabilities, every result identifies the server, server/discover is complete and cacheable, and explicit handles bind all cross-call state. Concurrent requests from changing clients cannot leak negotiated state. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
